title: Where do the Hindu numerals and zero matter in life?
description: Daily life, professions and computers are examined for the places where the Hindu numerals and zero play a part. The video then pictures life without them and checks the idea with a bill.
teaching_notes: One idea: place value with a zero lets ten digits write every number, and much of daily life and modern technology depends on it. Watch for students who think zero matters only in school sums.

video_script.why: The child uses the idea from reading four thousand seventy two that a zero holds an empty place, and applies it to daily life, professions and computers.
video_script.substitution: The zero now sits in prices, bills and computer storage, and the question is open, so there are several good answers.
video_script.anchor: the book's Hindu number system: ten digits from 0 to 9, with place value and a zero for an empty place
video_script.payoff_line: Money, time, phones, computers and science all depend on place value and zero.

final_answer.value: Open answer: money, time, phones, computing, accounting and science all depend on them; without them calculation would be slow and much of modern technology would be hard to build
